definition: Adobe Substance 3D Painter applies layered textures and material properties directly to 3D meshes.
example: A game artist adds worn paint and exposed metal to a modeled tool.

definition: Advertising design develops visual and verbal creative that communicates an offer to a target audience.
example: A designer lays out a poster so readers can quickly identify the event and ticket link.

definition: Aerospike Database is a distributed NoSQL database optimized for low-latency reads and writes at scale.
example: A personalization service reads a visitor profile during a request without scanning historical event logs.

definition: AG Grid is a JavaScript data-grid component for presenting and interacting with tabular data in web applications.
example: A trading dashboard lets users sort orders and group them by status.

definition: Agent evaluation measures how well an automated agent completes tasks within specified quality and behavior constraints.
example: A test suite checks whether a booking agent gets the correct price without committing an unapproved purchase.

definition: Agile software development delivers software in small increments and adjusts plans based on feedback and observed results.
example: A team tests a working checkout change with users before deciding which improvement to build next.

definition: Agricultural machinery comprises powered or mechanical equipment used to perform farming tasks such as planting, cultivation, and harvesting.
example: A grower uses a calibrated seed drill to place crops at a consistent spacing.

definition: AI copywriting uses generative models to assist with drafting or revising persuasive or informational text.
example: A marketer reviews model-generated variants of a product description against approved product facts.

definition: Air Travel Organisers’ Licensing is the United Kingdom’s licensing and consumer protection scheme for qualifying air travel arrangements.
example: A travel organizer checks whether a planned flight-inclusive package falls within the ATOL scheme.

definition: Ajax is a web development technique in which a browser exchanges data with a server without reloading the entire page.
example: A search box updates its suggestions while a visitor types.

definition: ÄKTA is a family of liquid chromatography systems used to separate and purify biomolecules.
example: A laboratory technician reviews chromatograms from an ÄKTA purification run.

definition: Aldus PhotoStyler was a raster graphics editor for editing and retouching photographs on personal computers.
example: A graphic artist adjusts the color of a scanned image before placing it in a publication.

definition: Alexa Internet was a web analytics service that reported website traffic estimates and popularity rankings.
example: A researcher compares archived site rankings while noting that they are estimates rather than direct traffic counts.

definition: Algorithm analysis examines the correctness and resource requirements of an algorithm as its inputs or assumptions vary.
example: An engineer compares the memory needs of two approaches to sorting a dataset.

definition: Alibaba Cloud provides managed computing, storage, networking, and other cloud infrastructure services.
example: A developer deploys an application on virtual servers and stores its backups in object storage.

definition: AlienVault refers to security monitoring and threat-intelligence products used to collect and correlate defensive security data.
example: An operations team combines logs from several systems to review suspicious account activity.
sense_note: The name can refer to the company or its products, including Unified Security Management.

definition: An all-terrain vehicle is a motorized vehicle designed for travel over rough or unpaved ground.
example: A land steward uses a suitable ATV to inspect a remote access road.

definition: Allergen labelling flags ingredients or cross-contact risks that may cause allergic reactions.
example: A food manufacturer checks that a product label identifies the relevant allergens in its recipe.

definition: AllJoyn was an open interoperability framework that allowed connected devices to discover and communicate with one another.
example: A home control app discovers a compatible device on a local network.

definition: AlloyUI is a web interface framework built on YUI that provides reusable JavaScript components.
example: A maintainer updates the date picker in an older portal that uses AlloyUI.

definition: Allyship is the practice of using one’s position and actions to support people facing exclusion or unequal treatment.
example: A meeting facilitator credits an overlooked colleague’s proposal and makes space for them to explain it.

definition: Alooma was a managed data integration platform for moving data from multiple sources into analytical destinations.
example: A data engineer synchronizes application events and customer records to a data warehouse.

definition: Alternative dispute resolution uses mechanisms such as mediation and arbitration to address disputes outside ordinary court proceedings.
example: Two parties ask a neutral mediator to help them negotiate a settlement.

definition: The Alternative Transients Program simulates electromagnetic transient behavior in electrical power systems.
example: A power engineer models the voltage transient following a switching operation.

definition: Aluminium smelting produces metallic aluminium by electrolytically reducing alumina dissolved in a molten bath.
example: A process engineer tracks electricity use at an aluminium smelter.

definition: Amazon AppStream 2.0 streams remotely hosted desktop applications to users without requiring a local installation of each application.
example: A university lets students use a licensed design tool through streamed sessions.

definition: Amazon CloudWatch collects operational metrics, logs, and events and can alert on monitored conditions.
example: An operations team sets an alarm for an unexpectedly high error rate.

definition: Amazon EMR manages infrastructure for distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark.
example: A team processes daily event files with Spark and writes summarized results to object storage.

definition: An Amazon Fire tablet is a touchscreen device that runs Fire OS and supports apps and media consumption.
example: A tester checks that an interactive reading app displays correctly on a Fire tablet.

definition: Amazon SageMaker is a set of managed cloud tools for building, training, deploying, and operating machine-learning models.
example: An engineer evaluates a trained classifier before exposing it through a managed inference endpoint.

definition: Amazon SimpleDB is a managed nonrelational data store that organizes records as items with named attributes.
example: A small application queries stored product items by a category attribute.

definition: amCharts is a JavaScript library for creating interactive charts and geographic visualizations on the web.
example: A publisher gives readers an interactive line chart of historical temperatures.

definition: American Welding Society codes define technical requirements for welding work within their specified scopes.
example: A welding inspector consults the applicable code when reviewing structural weld acceptance.

definition: Amiga refers to a family of personal computers known for their multimedia capabilities and the associated Amiga platform.
example: A preservation team tests whether an archived graphics program runs in a matching Amiga environment.

definition: AMX programming configures and writes control logic for AMX systems that coordinate audiovisual equipment and room controls.
example: An integrator programs a touch-panel selection to switch a conference room’s display source.
sense_note: The intended sense is audiovisual control, not Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions.

definition: Anaconda is a distribution and package-management ecosystem for Python and R workflows, particularly data science.
example: A scientist installs a project’s dependencies in an isolated conda environment.

definition: Analysis of variance is a statistical method that compares sources of variability to test hypotheses about differences in group means.
example: A researcher tests whether mean yield differs across several treatments.

definition: Anaplan is a cloud planning platform that links business data, forecasts, and scenarios across departments.
example: A retailer updates a demand forecast and checks its effect on staffing and cash plans.

definition: Android app development builds, tests, and maintains applications that run on Android devices.
example: A developer implements an offline mode and tests it on phones with different screen sizes.

definition: Android UI development designs and implements the screens, controls, and interaction behavior of Android applications.
example: A developer builds an accessible sign-in screen that adapts to portrait and landscape displays.
